# Notification Center Shadow Spec

> Notification Center — Persistent in-app alert system surfacing overdue transactions, month-end rollover reminders, and Safe to Spend health warnings

**Status:** Done
**Generated by:** spec-lead + @pseudo-worker

---

## Problem Statement

The app already detects and tracks financially critical events — overdue transactions, a deteriorating Safe to Spend, and approaching month-end rollovers — but surfaces none of them proactively. Users who don't happen to notice an overdue transaction in the calendar, or who don't check the Home screen on the last few days of the month, miss time-sensitive signals entirely. The notification bell in `HomeScreen` exists but does nothing (`onActionClick = {}`). Without an active alert surface, users cannot rely on the app to flag when their financial position needs attention; they must manually hunt for problems instead of being informed.

## Target User

A daily-to-weekly active user who opens the app to check their Safe to Spend or log a transaction. They are not financial analysts — they want the app to surface what needs their attention, not hide it inside lists they may not scroll to. They need to know: "is anything wrong right now?" without navigating away from the home screen.

## Success Metrics

- Bell badge count reflects undismissed notification count accurately at all times (zero false positives, zero missed events)
- Overdue notification content updates reactively within the same session when a new transaction becomes overdue
- Rollover reminder notifications are generated exactly once per (type × calendar month) — no duplicates across sessions
- STS Low and STS Negative are treated as two distinct notification types; both can be active simultaneously
- Profile page exposes the STS low threshold setting with a default of 15%
- All four notification types (Overdue, Rollover ×3, STS Low, STS Negative) generate, display, expand, and dismiss correctly end-to-end

## Out of Scope

- Push notifications (OS-level alerts when app is backgrounded) — this is in-app only
- Notification history past dismissal — once dismissed, a notification is gone from the center
- Notification preferences per type (e.g., "disable overdue alerts") — all types are always active
- Deep-link navigation from a notification item — items expand in place, no navigation
- Snooze or remind-later functionality
- Dashboard health panel (mentioned during discussion but explicitly deferred)
- Read/unread state — badge clears only on dismiss, not on open

## Non-Functional Requirements

- **Performance:** Notification generation at app launch runs synchronously within the existing `MarkOverdueTransactionsUseCase` hook — no additional startup delay beyond that hook. Reactive STS Flow subscription must not add observable recomposition lag to the Home screen.
- **Reliability:** Deduplication must be idempotent — calling the generation logic N times must produce the same result as calling it once. Rollover reminders must be scoped to (type × year × month) so they re-generate correctly in new months even if the previous month's were dismissed.
- **Correctness:** STS Low fires when `currentSts < (poolBalance × threshold / 100)`. STS Negative fires when `currentSts < 0`. Both conditions are evaluated independently; both notifications can be active simultaneously.
- **Data integrity:** Monetary values in the notifications table (projected_rollover, current_sts, pool_balance) are stored as `Long` cents, consistent with the rest of the schema.

## Data Model

```sudolang
// Notification type keys — stored as TEXT in DB
enum NotificationType {
  OVERDUE_TRANSACTIONS   = "overdue_transactions"
  ROLLOVER_REMINDER_7    = "rollover_reminder_7"
  ROLLOVER_REMINDER_5    = "rollover_reminder_5"
  ROLLOVER_REMINDER_3    = "rollover_reminder_3"
  STS_LOW                = "sts_low"
  STS_NEGATIVE           = "sts_negative"
}

// Domain model
interface Notification {
  id: Long;
  type: NotificationType;
  isDismissed: Boolean;

  // Rollover scoping — null for non-rollover types
  triggerMonth: Int?;        // 1–12
  triggerYear: Int?;

  // Payload fields — only relevant fields are non-null per type
  overdueCount: Int?;           // OVERDUE_TRANSACTIONS: count of overdue items
  projectedRollover: Long?;     // ROLLOVER_REMINDER_*: cents
  daysRemaining: Int?;          // ROLLOVER_REMINDER_*: days left in month
  currentSts: Long?;            // STS_LOW / STS_NEGATIVE: cents
  poolBalance: Long?;           // STS_LOW / STS_NEGATIVE: cents

  createdAt: Long;
  updatedAt: Long;
}

// Expanded detail — derived at display time, not stored
interface NotificationDetail {
  // For OVERDUE_TRANSACTIONS: fetched fresh from getOverdueTransactions query
  overdueTransactions: List<Transaction>?;
  // For ROLLOVER_REMINDER_*: from projectedRollover + daysRemaining on Notification
  // For STS_LOW / STS_NEGATIVE: from currentSts + poolBalance on Notification
}

// User settings
interface UserSettings {
  id: Long;                          // Always 1 — single row
  stsLowThresholdPercent: Int;       // 1–100, default 15
  createdAt: Long;
  updatedAt: Long;
}

// UI State
interface NotificationCenterUiState {
  notifications: List<Notification>;
  isLoading: Boolean;
  error: String?;
  expandedNotificationId: Long?;     // Which item is expanded (only one at a time)
}
```

## Constraints

```sudolang
// Deduplication rules
Constraint: For OVERDUE_TRANSACTIONS, STS_LOW, STS_NEGATIVE —
  at most one non-dismissed notification of that type may exist at any time.
  On generation: if a non-dismissed record exists → UPDATE payload + updatedAt.
  If no non-dismissed record exists → INSERT new record.

Constraint: For ROLLOVER_REMINDER_7, ROLLOVER_REMINDER_5, ROLLOVER_REMINDER_3 —
  at most one notification per (type × triggerYear × triggerMonth) may exist,
  regardless of dismissed status. On generation: if record exists for current
  (type, year, month) → skip. If not → INSERT new record.

// Trigger windows for rollover reminders
Constraint: ROLLOVER_REMINDER_7 fires when daysRemainingInMonth() == 7.
Constraint: ROLLOVER_REMINDER_5 fires when daysRemainingInMonth() == 5.
Constraint: ROLLOVER_REMINDER_3 fires when daysRemainingInMonth() == 3.
  daysRemainingInMonth() follows DateUtils convention — today counts as a remaining day.

// STS threshold evaluation
Constraint: STS_LOW fires when currentSts >= 0 AND currentSts < (poolBalance × threshold / 100).
Constraint: STS_NEGATIVE fires when currentSts < 0.
Constraint: STS_LOW and STS_NEGATIVE are evaluated independently and may both be active simultaneously.
Constraint: stsLowThresholdPercent must be in range [1, 100]. Default is 15.

// Monetary values
Constraint: All Long monetary fields in notifications are stored as cents (same as all other monetary values in the schema).

// Badge
Constraint: Badge count = COUNT of notifications WHERE is_dismissed = 0.
  Badge is not affected by opening the notification center — only by dismissal.

// Expansion
Constraint: Only one notification item may be expanded at a time (accordion behaviour).
  Tapping an already-expanded item collapses it.

// Overdue detail
Constraint: The expanded overdue transaction list is fetched live from getOverdueTransactions
  at render time — it is NOT stored in the notification payload. overdueCount on the
  Notification record is a summary field only.
```

## Data Flow

```sudolang
// Launch-time generation (called in same hook as MarkOverdueTransactionsUseCase)
AppStart / Foreground Resume
  |> MarkOverdueTransactionsUseCase.execute()
  |> GenerateNotificationsUseCase.execute()
       |> checkOverdueNotification(getOverdueTransactions())
       |> checkRolloverNotifications(DateUtils.daysRemainingInMonth(), CalculateMonthProjectionUseCase())
       |> checkStsNotifications(CalculateSafeToSpendUseCase(), getTotalPoolBalance(), UserSettings.threshold)
       |> upsert / insert notifications as needed

// Reactive STS generation (mid-session, wired in BudgetViewModel)
CalculateSafeToSpendUseCase Flow emits new STS value
  |> BudgetViewModel observes emission
  |> calls GenerateNotificationsUseCase.checkStsNotifications(newSts, poolBalance, threshold)
  |> upsert STS_LOW / STS_NEGATIVE notifications as needed
  |> GetUnreadNotificationCountUseCase Flow re-emits → badge updates

// Reactive overdue update (mid-session)
MarkOverdueTransactionsUseCase detects new overdue transition
  |> GenerateNotificationsUseCase.checkOverdueNotification()
  |> UPDATE existing OVERDUE_TRANSACTIONS notification (overdueCount, updatedAt) if non-dismissed
  |> GetUnreadNotificationCountUseCase Flow re-emits → badge updates

// Notification Center display
User taps bell icon
  |> NotificationCenterViewModel.loadNotifications()
  |> GetActiveNotificationsUseCase.execute() → Flow<List<Notification>>
  |> For OVERDUE item: also fetch getOverdueTransactions() for expanded detail
  |> Emit NotificationCenterUiState

// Dismiss single
User swipes / taps X on item
  |> DismissNotificationUseCase.execute(id)
  |> UPDATE notifications SET is_dismissed = 1 WHERE id = :id
  |> GetUnreadNotificationCountUseCase re-emits → badge decrements

// Dismiss all
User taps "Clear all"
  |> DismissAllNotificationsUseCase.execute()
  |> UPDATE notifications SET is_dismissed = 1 WHERE is_dismissed = 0
  |> Badge drops to 0

// Profile settings update
User adjusts STS threshold on profile page
  |> UpdateUserSettingsUseCase.execute(newThreshold)
  |> UPDATE user_settings SET sts_low_threshold_percent = :value, updated_at = :now WHERE id = 1
  |> Next STS Flow emission re-evaluates STS_LOW condition with new threshold
```

## Function Signatures

```sudolang
// Generation
fn GenerateNotifications(
  overdueTxns: List<Transaction>,
  daysRemaining: Int,
  projectedRollover: Long,
  currentSts: Long,
  poolBalance: Long,
  threshold: Int,
  now: Long                         // Unix ms for created_at / trigger_month / trigger_year
): Unit

// Queries
fn GetActiveNotifications(): Flow<List<Notification>>
fn GetUnreadNotificationCount(): Flow<Int>

// Actions
fn DismissNotification(id: Long): Result<Unit>
fn DismissAllNotifications(): Result<Unit>

// Settings
fn GetUserSettings(): Flow<UserSettings>
fn UpdateUserSettings(stsLowThresholdPercent: Int): Result<UserSettings>
```

## Database Schema

```sudolang
// New table: notifications
table notifications {
  id: Long PK AUTOINCREMENT
  type: TEXT NOT NULL             // NotificationType enum value
  is_dismissed: Integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0

  // Rollover scoping (null for non-rollover types)
  trigger_month: Integer          // 1–12; null for OVERDUE / STS types
  trigger_year: Integer           // e.g. 2026; null for OVERDUE / STS types

  // Payload — only relevant fields populated per type
  overdue_count: Integer          // OVERDUE_TRANSACTIONS only
  projected_rollover: Integer     // ROLLOVER_REMINDER_* only (cents)
  days_remaining: Integer         // ROLLOVER_REMINDER_* only
  current_sts: Integer            // STS_LOW / STS_NEGATIVE only (cents)
  pool_balance: Integer           // STS_LOW / STS_NEGATIVE only (cents)

  created_at: Integer NOT NULL
  updated_at: Integer NOT NULL
}

index idx_notifications_type_dismissed ON notifications(type, is_dismissed)
index idx_notifications_dismissed ON notifications(is_dismissed)
index idx_notifications_rollover ON notifications(type, trigger_year, trigger_month)

// New table: user_settings (single-row settings store)
table user_settings {
  id: Long PK DEFAULT 1           // Always 1
  sts_low_threshold_percent: Integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 15  // 1–100
  created_at: Integer NOT NULL
  updated_at: Integer NOT NULL
}
```

## SQLDelight Queries

```sudolang
// getActiveNotifications :many
SELECT * FROM notifications
WHERE is_dismissed = 0
ORDER BY created_at DESC;

// getUnreadCount :one
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notifications WHERE is_dismissed = 0;

// getNotificationByType :one
SELECT * FROM notifications
WHERE type = :type AND is_dismissed = 0
LIMIT 1;

// getNotificationByTypeAndMonth :one
SELECT * FROM notifications
WHERE type = :type AND trigger_year = :year AND trigger_month = :month
LIMIT 1;

// insertNotification :one
INSERT INTO notifications (
  type, is_dismissed,
  trigger_month, trigger_year,
  overdue_count, projected_rollover, days_remaining,
  current_sts, pool_balance,
  created_at, updated_at
) VALUES (
  :type, 0,
  :trigger_month, :trigger_year,
  :overdue_count, :projected_rollover, :days_remaining,
  :current_sts, :pool_balance,
  :created_at, :updated_at
) RETURNING *;

// updateNotificationPayload :exec
UPDATE notifications
SET overdue_count = :overdue_count,
    projected_rollover = :projected_rollover,
    days_remaining = :days_remaining,
    current_sts = :current_sts,
    pool_balance = :pool_balance,
    updated_at = :updated_at
WHERE id = :id;

// dismissNotification :exec
UPDATE notifications SET is_dismissed = 1, updated_at = :updated_at WHERE id = :id;

// dismissAllNotifications :exec
UPDATE notifications SET is_dismissed = 1, updated_at = :updated_at WHERE is_dismissed = 0;

// getUserSettings :one
SELECT * FROM user_settings WHERE id = 1;

// upsertUserSettings :exec
INSERT INTO user_settings (id, sts_low_threshold_percent, created_at, updated_at)
VALUES (1, :threshold, :created_at, :updated_at)
ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET
  sts_low_threshold_percent = :threshold,
  updated_at = :updated_at;
```

## Edge Cases

| Case | Condition | Handling |
|------|-----------|----------|
| All overdues resolved | User confirms/cancels all overdue transactions | OVERDUE_TRANSACTIONS notification is not auto-dismissed — stays until user dismisses manually; overdue_count becomes stale until next generation run |
| STS recovers above threshold | STS rises back above low/negative threshold mid-session | STS_LOW / STS_NEGATIVE notifications are not auto-dismissed — they persist until user dismisses. A future generation cycle will not insert a duplicate (deduplication) |
| Both STS_LOW and STS_NEGATIVE active | STS < 0 (both conditions true) | Both notifications coexist independently. User must dismiss each separately |
| Rollover reminder on non-trigger day | daysRemainingInMonth() is not 7, 5, or 3 | Skip rollover check entirely — no INSERT, no UPDATE |
| Month boundary during session | User keeps app open across midnight on a rollover trigger day | Launch-time check will catch it on next foreground resume; reactive generation does not poll time |
| No spending pool accounts | poolBalance == 0 | STS_LOW threshold % of 0 = 0; STS == 0 is not < 0 so STS_NEGATIVE does not fire. STS_LOW: 0 < 0 is false, so neither fires. No notification generated |
| user_settings row missing | First launch, no upsert yet | getUserSettings returns null → use default threshold of 15 in-memory; upsert on first profile save |
| Notification center opened with 0 notifications | All dismissed or never generated | Show empty state: "No new notifications" |
| Overdue notification content stale | New overdues added mid-session after notification was last generated | Reactive path in MarkOverdueTransactionsUseCase calls GenerateNotificationsUseCase.checkOverdueNotification() → UPDATE overdue_count + updatedAt |
